messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: metering-emitter (eu1) anomaly detected. metric=token_count_gap value=+1.2M over 7m. Pager -> @oncall_jess. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift

oncall_jess: ack — investigating now

billing_sre_anna: seeing +12k t/min from emitter-proxy-3 starting ~01:32Z, kafka lag spiked. possibly duplicate writes :thinking_face:

eng_runtime_tom: pulling recent emitter logs, grep shows repeated batch_ids
```
2026-03-20T01:32:11Z emitter-proxy-3 emit_batch id=bd3f4 seq=1001 count=1200
2026-03-20T01:32:12Z emitter-proxy-3 emit_batch id=bd3f4 seq=1001 count=1200
2026-03-20T01:32:13Z emitter-proxy-3 emit_batch id=bd3f4 seq=1001 count=1200
```

eng_ml_adele: KV cache TTL could explain replay if the seq commit didn't persist. can we confirm emitter sequence numbers in the DB?

oncall_jess: can we flip writes to backup emitter and pause billing-scoring ingestion? @ops_lead_ryan

ops_lead_ryan: On it. Pausing billing-scoring ingestion now -> `./ops/pause_ingest --service billing-scoring`

deploy-bot: cmd run: pause_ingest succeeded (job id 98321). Canary route set to backup-emitter-eu1 for 10m.

billing_sre_anna: switching write target reduced emission rate on graph. I'll run a dedupe dry-run for the 01:30-01:40Z window before allowing scoring.
`python tools/dedupe_window.py --start 2026-03-20T01:30Z --end 2026-03-20T01:40Z --dry-run`

cs_max: quick check on customer-facing systems: two accounts (acct_1122, acct_7788) got overage FLAGs and one automated email went out. escalating to support.

oncall_jess: how many excess tokens approx? ETA to stop?

billing_sre_anna: after flip to backup, emission dropped to baseline in ~90s. estimated excess tokens emitted ~1.18M total across eu1 window. we'll need to reconcile and credit impacted accounts.

eng_runtime_tom: root cause hypothesis: emitter-proxy-3 restarted and replayed uncommitted batches (batch_id dedup missing). quick fix in PR 4521 adds idempotency guard for emit_batch and stronger seq commit. https://redwood.internal/pulls/4521

ops_lead_ryan: can we run the dedupe safely? risk of dropping legit events?

billing_sre_anna: plan: dry-run -> validate against consumer ledger -> apply. dry-run shows ~1.17M duplicates. proceeding with manual reconcile window now. will snapshot before mutate.

cs_max: opened support ticket TKT-4591, drafted notification and credit estimate. assigning to support-team for outbound comms.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy started - canary on emitter-proxy-3 (PR 4521). rolling 50% -> 100% if canary is green.

eng_runtime_tom: canary looks good, no further duplicate batches observed in canary window. merging and rolling.

oncall_jess: do not re-enable billing-scoring ingest until reconcile validated.

billing_sre_anna: agree. reconcile ETA ~15m; will re-enable ingest 10m after reconcile completes.

cs_max: :white_check_mark: customer notifications queued, will send once reconcile confirms final numbers.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering-emitter duplicate-replay (eu1). severity=P2. summary: excess_tokens=1.18M, customers_impacted=2, estimated_credit=~$850. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/metering-7901234567

oncall_jess: thanks team — follow-up postmortem and action items (idempotency + commit checks + alert tuning) scheduled. :thumbsup:
